tldr: Adds partial order refunds through POST /refunds, idempotent by the Idempotency-Key header, with an email to the customer.
goal: Let support give back part of an order's amount without charging twice.

story.heading: New use case Refunds::Create
story.body: Support can refund part of an order. A retry with the same key does not charge again.

story.heading: Order now computes what is refundable
story.body: The amount rule lives in the model, not in the service.

story.heading: Table refunds added
story.body: Each refund stores its amount and a unique idempotency key. An order has 0 or more refunds.

story.heading: The gateway receives the idempotency key
story.body: Gateway.refund passes Idempotency-Key on to the payment gateway.

story.heading: The customer gets an email at the end
story.body: deliver_later: if SMTP is down, the refund does not fail.

story.heading: 5 components, 0 violations
story.body: Every new dependency goes web → application → domain/infra.

components.summary: New route POST /refunds; the controller requires Idempotency-Key and delegates.
New use case: deduplicates by key, records the refund, calls the gateway and notifies.
New Refund model; Order computes the refundable amount and creates refunds.
The gateway exposes refund(), passing the idempotency key on.

decisions.title: Idempotency through the Idempotency-Key header
decisions.why: The client controls retries, and the same key reaches the gateway.
decisions.alternative: Deduplicate by (order, amount) within a time window.

decisions.title: The amount rule lives in Order
decisions.why: Order knows its total and its refunds; the service only coordinates the calls.

decisions.title: Email in the background
decisions.why: deliver_later neither blocks the response nor fails the refund if SMTP is down.
